identity_evidence.quote: Sixty seven‐year‐old patient presented with biopsy‐proven recurrence of prostate carcinoma

attribution_limitations: The Key Clinical Message, Introduction and Discussion say the patient remained continent and potent / regained his pretreatment potency and continence stage, and the Conclusion says IIEF5 and IPSS scores were fully restored, while the Results report IPSS 2 of 35 at baseline versus 5 of 35 with mild incontinence and urine leakage about once a day, IIEF-5 21 versus 16 then 19, and the Discussion says IIEF5 was almost restored after 6 months. These are qualitative characterizations of score ranges, not two different values for one measurement, so they are recorded as an ambiguity.

The Conclusion lists mild hematuria of the prostate and slight transient urge incontinence as mild adverse events of the treatment. The Discussion states that no adverse events resulted from bleomycin administration or the electroporation procedure (a cause-scoped statement, not the same attribute as the overall adverse-event list), yet describes minor urge incontinence as remaining; the Figure 3A caption says no hematuria can be seen on the 1-day MRI, and the Results never mention hematuria. Timing and cause of the hematuria are unstated.

The timing of androgen deprivation therapy before ECT is given as 4 weeks to the first follow-up MRI plus ECT 6 weeks later, as three months prior to treatment, and as three months of ADT in the Figure 1 caption.

The IPSS and IIEF-5 results after treatment (5 and 16; still 5 and 19) are printed without their own time points; the 8-week and 6-month assignment follows paragraph sequence only. The Discussion and Conclusion describe restoration at 6 months without printing the scores, so the 6-month time is not attached to the numeric values.

The sphincter is called the bladder sphincter, external urethral sphincter, sphincter externus and lower urinary sphincter; PSA is 7.1 ng/mL at presentation and 7 ng/mL pretreatment; ADC units are printed as mm^(2)/sec; Figure 1 caption writes AHD for ADT; the questionnaire is spelled IPPS and IPSS.
The PI-RADS category is printed as PIRADS 6; kept as printed.
